name: downtime_coc_mode_skills
evaluator_instructions: Judge this as a black-box solo TRPG product. Verify: (1) GM enters downtime mode with enter_mode downtime. (2) GM presents a proposal with ≥3 categories of downtime mechanics (healing/recovery, sanity/psychology, skill training, finances, social/contacts). (3) Player confirms and GM resolves batch settlement with advance_time + apply_effect/change_track. (4) A settlement summary is delivered. (5) GM calls exit_mode when downtime is complete. DB should show world_time_advances and generic_parameter_states records.
